title: Native Codex projection and AgentManager ownership, observations and outcome journal

operationId.description: Caller-generated <runtimeEpoch>:<issuedAtUnixMs>:<nonce>. Read runtimeEpoch from hive_status, use current Unix milliseconds and a unique 1-128 character nonce without a colon. Valid for 24 hours and at most 60 seconds in the future; a Hive restart changes the epoch. Keep this exact ID and check agent_manager_read after an uncertain result.
